# Minimal — Brand Schema Template

This directory contains the smallest valid Ramoira v2.0.0 brand schema. It passes SPEC.schema.json and SPEC.summary.schema.json validation with every required field present and no optional fields.

## Files

- `brand.schema.json` — full schema template. All required fields. Replace placeholder values with real brand content.
- `brand.schema.summary.json` — summary schema template. Replace placeholder values before publishing.

## How to use

1. Copy `brand.schema.json` to your project directory
2. Fill in all placeholder values (search for "adjective-one", "tone-one", etc.)
3. Run `ramoira validate` to confirm the schema is valid
4. Run `ramoira publish` to publish the summary to ramoira.com

Or generate a fully populated schema from scratch: `ramoira init`

## Spec

Full schema spec: https://github.com/ramoira/brand-schema-spec
